issue: #762 - Make CDN URLs configurable in FastAPI

changes.description: Added swagger_js_url, swagger_css_url, swagger_favicon_url, redoc_js_url, redoc_favicon_url, with_google_fonts constructor parameters to FastAPI.__init__ with sensible defaults matching the existing hardcoded CDN URLs
Stored new parameters as instance attributes in __init__
Passed swagger_js_url, swagger_css_url, swagger_favicon_url to get_swagger_ui_html() in setup()
Passed redoc_js_url, redoc_favicon_url, with_google_fonts to get_redoc_html() in setup()
Added test verifying custom CDN URLs are used in Swagger UI and ReDoc
